vaultSummary: Reveal Datasets and Ad Hoc Queries that are dependent on other Datasets or Datasources.

fields.label: Id
fields.description: Source Dataset or Ad Hoc Query UUID.

fields.label: Flow
fields.description: Array of Flow steps.  Each flow step in the array is stored as an Object.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Source Dataset or Ad Hoc Query Name.

fields.label: Dependent Dataset Id
fields.description: The Dataset UUID that the source query is dependent upon.  Each source query can have more than one dependency.

fields.label: Dependent Dataset Name
fields.description: The Dataset Name that the source query is dependent upon.  Each source query can have more than one dependency.  This is the information pulled from the "METADATA-Reports-Dataset Ids Names" joined dataset.

fields.label: Link To Report
fields.description: Clickable link to the source Dataset or Ad Hoc  Report.

fields.label: Dependent Dataset Link
fields.description: Clickable link to the dependent Dataset.

fields.label: Num Of Dependent Datasets
fields.description: Number of dependent Datasets that the source query is dependent upon.

fields.label: Num Of Dependent Datasources
fields.description: Number of dependent Datasources that the source query is dependent upon.
